description: Renders a PDF and returns a signed download URL (valid until expires_at). Give EITHER template_id with data (the usual way: see get_template_fields for the data shape) OR raw html (with optional css; the html may use Liquid tags such as {{ name }} filled from data). By default it makes a TEST document (watermarked, not counted); set test to false only when the user explicitly asks for a live/final document.

css.description: CSS for raw html. Not allowed with template_id (a template carries its own CSS).

data.description: The values for the template, as a JSON object (nested objects and arrays allowed). Left out: the template sample data is used.

filename.description: File name of the PDF, e.g. "invoice-1042.pdf".

format.description: Page size: A4, A5, Letter, Legal, or { width, height } such as "210mm". Default: the template setting, else A4.

html.description: Raw HTML to render instead of a template (a full document or a fragment).

margins.description: CSS-style margins with units, e.g. "20mm" or "10mm 15mm 10mm 15mm".

mode.description: fast (default) or print (paged media: page numbers, running headers).

template_id.description: A template id from list_templates. Leave out when giving html.

template_version.description: Render this template version instead of the pinned or current one.

test.description: true (default): a watermarked test document that is not counted against the plan. Set false ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a live, final, unwatermarked document. A test API key always makes test documents.

name: create_pdf
title: Create a PDF
